products.name: Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Setting Spray
why: Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Setting Spray keeps makeup in place all day and stops foundation from settling into fine lines or wrinkles.
It is recommended by Glamour editors and tested on editors and contributors across skin types and tones.
products.desc: A fine mist applied over completed makeup to lock in the look. It has a lightweight formula that does not leave a powdery finish.
products.benefit: Picture a long day at work or a night out—this spray keeps foundation from settling into fine lines and keeps your look fresh. The spray has a lightweight mist that doesn’t feel heavy, making it suitable for all skin types. It outperforms other picks in this guide by providing the longest wear time and the most consistent finish. The catch: it is the most expensive option in this guide.
products.best_for: Everyone looking for long‑lasting, fresh makeup
products.skip_if: You have a very tight budget
